outputs.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: SIX original battle-animation raster poses TWO columns THREE rows, generous empty gutters. ONE long straight wooden/brass BLOWPIPE with TWO orange feathers tied near its MUZZLE, no stock, trigger or bow limbs. Same elevated three-quarter battle camera and original proportions. All living poses face RIGHT. Top-left: melee anticipation, both elbows bent pulling tube horizontally back across chest, RIGHT hand rear near mouthpiece, LEFT hand forward, feathered muzzle ALWAYS points RIGHT. Top-right: recovery after two-hand shove right, draw same tube halfway back toward chest, same hand ownership and muzzle still RIGHT. Bottom-left: intermediate collapse from kneeling toward LEFT: hips and knees grounded at screen RIGHT, torso tips down LEFT, LEFT forearm braces near ground below face, right hand loosely holds tube beside body pointing its feathered muzzle to RIGHT. Same cape/quiver/goggles, body size throughout, no gear/hand swapping or mirror. Full tube/feathers/boots and hair inside each panel. Original painted raster on flat pure green #00FF00 background without spill/shadow. No text, grid, scenery, gore, particles or extra props.
